bullets.title: seeking roughly 20 patients for the first-ever Alzheimer’s study using psilocybin as an intervention
bullets.note:
Both sides of my family have suffered from Alzheimer’s disease (AD), and this study is one of the reasons I [committed more than $2MM](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavhre630ug/m7u7h5hnq6eon6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubnl0aW1lcy5jb20vMjAxOS8wOS8wNi9oZWFsdGgvZmVycmlzcy1wc3ljaGVkZWxpYy1kcnVncy1kZXByZXNzaW9uLmh0bWw=) to the [Johns Hopkins Center for Psychedelic and Consciousness Research](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavhre630ug/eziph7hnl34kn8/aHR0cHM6Ly9ob3BraW5zcHN5Y2hlZGVsaWMub3JnLw==). Dr. Albert Garcia-Romeu and team will be investigating psilocybin’s effects on AD-related depression, as well as memory and cognitive function. I’m bullish.

For the study, people in the mid-Atlantic area near Baltimore/DC are ideal, but people willing to travel will also be considered if they meet inclusion criteria. To learn more about the study and application process, please visit this website: [](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavhre630ug/dvfeh0h7o95q7g/aHR0cHM6Ly9ob3BraW5zcHN5Y2hlZGVsaWMub3JnL2FsemhlaW1lcnM=)[https://hopkinspsychedelic.org/alzheimers](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/n4u05gdnnavhre630ug/e8tph7hnl34kng/aHR0cHM6Ly9ob3BraW5zcHN5Y2hlZGVsaWMub3JnL2FsemhlaW1lcnM=).
